current_evidence: The council's 'Local information requirements' page (info/20160/planning_applications/2494) and 'What to submit with your planning application' page (last updated 5 August 2022) point to 'Local Information Requirements for Planning Applications' (downloads/file/24677, PDF 738 KB). That PDF could not be fetched as text, so its date is unconfirmed. The earlier copy Grokbot read (id 7362, local_validation_criteria_2021.pdf) is headed 'Local Information Requirements for Planning Applications, December 2021'.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' is the type-specific 'Application for Full Planning Permission checklist' (download id 1080), not the local validation list. The council's local list is a separate document, 'Local Information Requirements for Planning Applications'. The id 1080 PDF also returned a client error when fetched.
issues.evidence: Council page 'Local information requirements': 'View our Local Information Requirements list' -> downloads/file/24677/local_information_requirements_for_planning_applications

issues.detail: The local list Grokbot actually read (id 7362, local_validation_criteria_2021.pdf, December 2021) is not the file the council's current pages link to (file 24677). The 24677 PDF could not be read, so it is unconfirmed whether its contents differ (for example, BNG wording that postdates 2021).
issues.evidence: Search results show id 7362 as 'local validation criteria 2021' / '2018' / '2020' file names; current pages link file 24677

issues.detail: The List date 2022-01-01 comes from the PDF metadata CreationDate of a checklist, not from any document text. The local list text says December 2021. No date was visible for the current file 24677.
issues.evidence: reference_row 'Date basis': 'PDF metadata CreationDate'; local list cover: 'Local Information Requirements for Planning Applications ... December 2021'

issues.detail: Several local-list requirements appear in no application-type row: Aerodrome Safeguarding Assessment (buildings or structures over 90m, or affecting protected surfaces, navigation aids or bird hazard); Coal Mining Risk Assessment (full (not change of use), outline or minerals applications within a Coal Mining Referral Area); Health Impact Assessment (all applications requiring EIA); Mineral Deposits Investigation (sites over 5ha); Site Waste Strategy (sites over 5ha; appears only as stray text inside the Structural Survey trigger); Parking Management Plan/Strategy (any application proposing parking; appears only as stray text in other triggers); Places of worship and faith-related community use information (all such applications); Student Accommodation Statement and Management Plan (off-campus student accommodation, or conversions of over 1,000 sqm); Sustainable Construction Statement (all major development).
issues.evidence: local_validation_criteria_2021.pdf headings: 'Aerodrome Safeguarding Assessment', 'Coal Mining Risk Assessment', 'Health Impact Assessment', 'Mineral Deposits Investigation', 'Site Waste Strategy', 'Parking Management Plan/ Strategy', 'Places of worship...', 'Student Accommodation Statement...', 'Sustainable Construction Statement'

issues.detail: Some items are captured inconsistently and are missing from Full planning even though the list applies them to full applications. Sustainable Drainage Assessment plus O&M Plan (all major) and Tall Buildings Report (over 15 storeys) appear only under Outline and Reserved matters. Lighting Assessment appears under Outline, Reserved matters and Advertisement consent but not Full planning. The CIL Additional Information Form (over 100 sqm of new floorspace or change of use, or a new dwelling, including prior approvals) appears only under Householder and Listed building consent, not Full or Outline.
issues.evidence: Local list: 'Sustainable Drainage Assessment ... All major development'; 'Tall Buildings Report ... Any building over 15 storeys'; 'CIL Additional Information Form ... >100 sqm new floorspace ... new dwelling'

issues.detail: Two triggers are entirely wrong. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' (Full and Outline) carries the retail text ('An impact assessment is required for retail, leisure and office development proposals greater than 2,500sqm...'), with nothing about flood. 'Fire Statement' (Full, Outline, LBC, Adverts) carries the Flood Risk Assessment text ('A site specific flood risk assessment will be required ... flood zones 2 and 3'), so the real fire trigger (relevant high-rise buildings 18m+/7+ storeys) is lost.
issues.evidence: Local list: 'Fire Statement: relevant buildings ... works to them, development within their curtilage, or change of use'

issues.detail: Many other triggers are cut off or taken from the wrong item. Design and Access Statement: 'Required only for' (cut off). Daylight/Sunlight (Full): the tail of the guidance plus 'Energy Statement ... All planning applications for major development'. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity': landscaping and land-contamination text. Photographs (Full): Works to Trees text. Photographs (Householder): 'All applications where parking is proposed' (the Parking Management Plan trigger). Telecommunications (Householder): 'all telecommunication mast applications. Tree Survey'. Transport Assessment: 'Where the development requires a Transport Assessment' (circular). Structural Survey (Full): starts with 'Site Waste Strategy Applications for sites over 5ha'. Advertisement drawings: 'method of illumination All applications for major development'.

The Listed building consent rows (31) come from the combined 'Full Planning Permission and Listed Building Consent' checklist (26) and the 'Householder and LBC' checklist (5). As a result, planning-only items are attributed to LBC: Affordable Housing Statement (15+ dwellings), Air Quality, Energy Statement, CIL Form, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan, Open Space, Viability, Telecoms, Fire Statement, NDSS. The standalone 'Application for Listed Building Consent checklist' (id 1077) was read but not used. The local list ties LBC mainly to the Heritage Statement, Structural Survey, Photographs and Planning Statement.

28 of the 29 Advertisement consent rows come from the combined 'Full Planning Permission and consent to display advertisements' checklist. This lists Affordable Housing Statement, Energy Statement, Travel Plan, Flood Risk Assessment, Open Space, Viability, S106 Heads of Terms and so on for advert consent. Only 'Lighting Assessment' comes from the standalone advert checklist (id 1075).

All six 'Change of use - prior approval' rows come from the telecoms prior notification checklist, for example 'All applications for masts within 3km of Birmingham International Airport...'. They describe telecoms code-operator prior approvals, not change-of-use prior approvals.

Householder lists items whose own triggers show they do not apply to householder works: 'Housing mix / dwelling standards (NDSS)' (new dwellings), Daylight/Sunlight ('new dwelling'), Telecommunications (masts) and Advertisement drawings. Four Householder rows come from the Householder+LBC checklist. Outline has 10 rows sourced from the Reserved Matters checklist. Separately, 6 local-list items are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Contaminated Land, Marketing evidence, Schedule of works), although the list applies them more widely.
issues.evidence: Householder trigger 'new dwelling ☐ Daylight/ Sunlight Assessment'; Outline sources include application_for_reserved_matters_following_an_outline_approval_checklist.pdf x10

issues.detail: All 8 'Submission rules' tab items are just checklist titles scraped from the downloads page (e.g. 'Application for Full Planning Permission checklist ... File type:'). 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' under Full planning ('Agency for pre-application advice when developing adjacent to a river or stream') is advice, not a validation requirement. The first drawing-standards item is a fragment with a stray page number ('As defined in the ... Order 2015 7 The document should normally include...').

The same text is reused across different requirements: Fire Statement and Flood Risk Assessment share one trigger; Sequential (flood) and Retail share one; Landscaping, Street scene and Extraction share one block. The same 'Elevations ... 1:50 or 1:100' drawing standard is repeated in 4 tab items from different checklists.

summary: Grokbot links to a single application-type checklist (Full planning) rather than Birmingham's Local Information Requirements list (current file 24677; the version read is dated December 2021), and dates it from PDF metadata. The extraction misses about nine local-list requirements, garbles key triggers (fire statement and flood sequential test) and puts many planning-only items under LBC, Advertisement and Prior approval by reading combined checklists.
